$meta.name: ZeroLatency DS
$meta.source: 200 reference frames of the app (ScreenShotFrames100/, ScreenShotFrames200/); measurements in design-system/frame-audit.md
$meta.note: Role tokens are the public API; primitives are for building roles only. Colors in hex (8-digit = alpha).

usage.bg: Main canvas: thread list, open thread, side panels, settings content. Measured #ffffff / #161616.
usage.bg-sidebar: Sidebar, settings navigation, onboarding left pane. Measured #f6f6f6 / #1c1c1c.
usage.surface-raised: Floating layers: menus, popovers, composer, modal, hover preview (always with a shadow). Dark measured #202020.
usage.surface-input: Filled text fields (Filter by…, view name, property name). No border until focus. Measured #f6f6f6.
usage.surface-hover: Hover fill for rows, menu items, sidebar items and icon buttons. Measured #f0f0f0 / #262626–#2a2a2a.
usage.surface-selected: Selected sidebar item, active settings section, open thread row. Measured #e8e8e8 / #262626.
usage.surface-tooltip: Tooltip body (dark in both themes). Measured #10110e–#181914.
usage.border: Hairlines: group-heading rules, panel edges, menu section dividers. Decorative (not a control boundary).
usage.border-strong: Control outlines that must be seen: checkbox box, radio ring, secondary button edge. Meets 3:1.
usage.text: Primary text: senders, subjects, menu labels, headings, email body. On every bg/surface role.
usage.text-muted: Sidebar item labels, read-row senders in dense views, secondary menu text.
usage.text-subtle: Timestamps, counts, section labels ("Views", "Mail"), descriptions, account email. Still AA on every ground.
usage.text-placeholder: Placeholders, "Draft saved", "(Gmail)" hints, thread counts next to a sender. Source value: below 4.5:1 by design, never for content the user must read.
usage.accent: Primary buttons (Send, Save, Continue), unread dot, active toolbar icon, checked checkbox. Measured #1e77dd·#186dc7 (nudged to #1c72d6 so white labels pass 4.5:1).
usage.accent-active: Pressed accent fills and the split-button divider.
usage.accent-fg: Text and icons on accent fills.
usage.accent-subtle: Selected option tint ("Included"), AI label chip, focused option row.
usage.accent-text: Accent-coloured text: links, "Included", active filter icon.
usage.accent-border: Outline of a selected option card (onboarding "Included" rows). Decorative; paired with text.
usage.focus-ring: Focus-visible outline (2px solid), and the 1px border of a focused input. Meets 3:1.
usage.focus-halo: Soft 3px halo around a focused input, outside the 1px focus-ring border. Decorative.
usage.overlay: Scrim behind the settings modal and template gallery. Measured: white dims to #626262.
usage.danger: Destructive icon/text (Delete view, Trash). Pair with a word.
usage.danger-text: Destructive labels on bg or raised surfaces.
usage.danger-subtle: Destructive button hover tint; error field message ground.
usage.tag-gray-bg: Gray label chip / status pill fill.
usage.icon-gray: Gray glyph: view icons, status dots, template icons. Decorative, always next to a text label.

usage.icon-brown: Brown glyph: view icons, status dots, template icons. Decorative, always next to a text label.

sans.stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
sans.usage: All UI and marketing text. Renders SF Pro on Apple devices and Segoe UI on Windows, as in the reference frames.

mono.stack: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
mono.usage: Keyboard shortcuts, code blocks, raw IDs.

motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all transitions/animations drop to 0.01ms except opacity fades (kept at duration.fast). No transform-based movement.
